system.description:
You manifest a swarm of Fire release constructs in the shape of butterflies. This swarm occupies a 60-foot cube centered on a point you can see within range and can occupy the spaces of multiple creatures as they flutter around them.

Until the beginning of your next turn, creatures that move more than 5 feet, detonates the fluttering butterflies around them, being forced to make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save they take

Creatures caught in the explosion (including casters) make a Dexterity saving throw at disadvantage. On a failed save they take 8d6+8 Fire damage and having their movement speed reduced by 10. On a successful save they take half damage and no further effects.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above A-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and the size of this jutsu by 10 feet and the damage by 1d6+1.
